title: What happened in AI — Sep 30, 2026
intro: OpenAI's DevDay shipped a Decisions API and Agents API, while Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Argon. The day's practical work was in operating agents: verification harnesses, rule-compliance checks and sprawl control.
Security and sovereignty ran alongside. OpenAI reported a distillation campaign, Anthropic flagged GLM-5.3's exploit skill, and DeepSeek tied its tooling to Huawei Ascend.
highlights: OpenAI DevDay: Decisions API, Agents API, Spaces and Marketplace.
Gemini 4 Argon announced by Google DeepMind.
CodeScene's agents refactored 300K lines of C for about $4,000, verified by replay.
OpenAI says it disrupted a model-reasoning distillation campaign.
DeepSeek and Huawei partner on chip programming tools to cut Nvidia reliance.
Kimi K3 enters OpenAI's enterprise Codex channel.
